This combo may also trigger the occasional Perfect Guard! |author= Nintendo |published= |retrieved= October 5, 2021 |url= https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/hyrule-warriors-age-of-calamity-switch/ |title= Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity |site= Nintendo |type= }} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 1 |durability = 10 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Pot Lid}} Pot Lids are lids of large soup pots that can be used as [[Shield]]s in combat. It is said that they smell of poultry, likely due to being used for [[Cooking]]. They are also considered to be quite [[Durability|Durable]]. They can often be found next to [[Cooking Pot]]s at [[Stable]]s or other settlements, such as [[Hateno Village]] and [[Kakariko Village]]. They can also be found in some [[Monster Stronghold]]s, where they are wielded by [[Bokoblin]]s, and rarely, [[Moblin]]s. According to ''[[Daruk's Training Journal]]'', [[Link]] once used a Pot Lid to defeat a [[Guardian]] by deflecting its laser after it began acting erratically during an experiment.{{Cite|I hear one of those ancient machine things went nuts during some test and shot out deadly beams! With true Goron spirit, Link grabbed a pot lid from the ground and deflected the blast. He nailed the thing in its weak spot and saved the day.|Daruk's Training Journal|BotW}} Being made of wood, Pot Lids will burn and eventually disintegrate if they touch [[Fire]] or are equipped in a [[Scorching Climate]]. They will also float if they are dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], and they will not attract [[Lightning]] during [[Thunderstorm]]s or conduct [[Electricity]]. Finally, Pot Lids cannot be picked up with the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]]. {{BotW Shield Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Shield_040" |Life = 10 |GuardPower = 1 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMin = 1 |SharpWeaponAddGuardMax = 2 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 20 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMin = 3 |PoweredSharpAddGuardMax = 20 |RideBreakRatio = 1.0 |MirrorLevel = 0 |SurfingFriction = 1.0 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Shield |strength = 1 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Pot Lid}} {{Stub|TotK}} Pot Lids reappear in {{TotK}}. ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} Pot Lids can be wielded by Link in conjunction with [[Soup Ladle]]s, the [[Lucky Ladle]], or the [[Training Sword]]. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} == See Also == {{See Also| * Shield * Wooden Shield }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Shields |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
